edges.reason: Constructor reads msg.sender to assign the full supply and emit the mint Transfer.
msg.sender is used as the key when writing balances.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
allowed[msg.sender][spender] is written with caller-controlled indexing.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] from the caller address.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller address.
Constructor stores the token name.
Constructor stores the token symbol.
Constructor stores the decimals value.
Constructor mints and stores _totalSupply.
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
transfer updates both the sender and recipient entries of balances.
transferFrom updates the from and to entries of balances.
transferFrom decrements the caller spender allowance in allowed.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply without a lower-bound check.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
transfer reads balances[msg.sender] and balances[to] before updating them.
transferFrom reads balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom reads allowed[from][msg.sender] before decrementing it.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the balance and the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
safeSub executes the guarded a - b subtraction.
safeAdd executes the guarded a + b addition.
safeMul executes the guarded a * b multiplication.
safeDiv executes the guarded a / b division.
totalSupply performs the unprotected _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] operation.
Result of safeAdd is written back into the balances mapping.
Result of safeSub is written back into the balances mapping.
Result of safeSub on the allowance is written back into allowed.
tokenOwner parameter is used to index balances in balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter is the allowance key in approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value stored by approve.
to parameter is the credited address in transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transfer.
from parameter is the debited owner in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited address in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom.
First operand flows into safeAdd.
Second operand flows into safeAdd.
Local return variable c holds safeAdd's result.
Minuend flows into safeSub.
Subtrahend flows into safeSub.
First operand flows into safeMul.
Second operand flows into safeMul.
Dividend flows into safeDiv.
Divisor flows into safeDiv and is required to be greater than zero.
tokens argument is subtracted from the sender balance through safeSub in transfer.
tokens argument is subtracted from balances and allowances through safeSub in transferFrom.
